name: Poppy
notes: Iron Ambassador (P) is assumed already off cooldown at the start of the fight; its cooldown is read from the wiki's explicit by-level table and is treated as a fixed timer NOT reduced by ability haste (the wiki marks it 'static'), the common reading for this kind of innate proc.

The empowered attack's bonus magic damage is applied as an on-hit rider on the first attack after the passive's cooldown elapses, checked at the start of the attack (before windup) per the wiki's note that the throw is skipped if windup has already begun; the bonus range and the buckler pickup/shield never matter against a stationary dummy and are ignored.

Hammer Shock (Q) is cast on cooldown: it has a 0.3325 s cast time (gen.Q.castTimeS), which keeps Poppy busy (no other cast, no attack) until it ends; the impact damage lands on cast, and the field's rupture, which deals the same damage again, is scheduled 1 second later as the same cast instance so it does not re-trigger cast-only item procs a second time.

Heroic Charge (E) is cast on cooldown for its single dash-in hit only: it has no cast time but still cannot start inside another cast; the fight has no terrain, so the wall-collision second hit and stun never occur.

Steadfast Presence (W) is cast on cooldown and its magic damage is credited every cast: normally it only lands if an enemy dashes into the aura and is interrupted, which a stationary dummy never does, but per the dossier's alternative reading we assume the interrupt for build-comparison purposes (an open question flagged as high impact); it has no cast time so it costs nothing beyond respecting another cast in progress.

Keeper's Verdict (R) is opened at t=0 (the engine's automatic opening cast), channelled for exactly the 0.5 s minimum needed to reach the charged (2x) damage tier, then released with its 0.35 s charged cast time: attacks are held through the whole channel and release cast via next_attack, and its cooldown starts when the damage lands (post-effect). The dummy is assumed to stay in front of Poppy in melee range so the direct swing lands rather than the shockwave/eruption sub-path, avoiding any double-count question there.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Poppy's costs bind within a 15 s fight at level 16 given her cooldowns.
